hints.title: Two Diagonal Definitions
hints.text: The primary diagonal consists of cells mat[i][i]. The secondary diagonal consists of cells mat[i][n - 1 - i].

hints.title: Single Pass Summation
hints.text: Loop i from 0 through n - 1, summing both diagonal cells mat[i][i] and mat[i][n - 1 - i].

hints.title: Odd Dimension Overlap Deduction
hints.text: If n is odd, the exact center element mat[n // 2][n // 2] is visited on both diagonals and must be subtracted once.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Visiting every cell in the matrix takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Iterating directly through diagonal indices achieves optimal O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles the center intersection element when n is odd cleanly.
complexity.notes: Matrix is square n x n.
